prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1414; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision referenced in your file. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care, with treatment ongoing. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

Your insured's obligation to preserve evidence extends to all materials relevant to this loss. Please ensure that the vehicle involved, its event data recorder information, photographs, dashcam or telematics footage, claim notes, adjuster recordings, and all statements taken from any party or witness are retained and not altered, repaired, or discarded while this claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and the steps you are taking to comply with these requests.
